description: Issue #286: a local query cannot reuse tags that read earlier stage input.
grammar:
%rule text "1" r
%rule r "a"
:: $.preceding-tokens.tags
%check chosen #·r
%conditions _General_Category_Decimal_Number ⊆ $.tags
%warning "chosen has digit"
%check local #·r
%conditions _General_Category_Decimal_Number ⊆ $.local-readings.tags
%warning "local has digit"
